name: Mie Hun · Wu Jiaqi
source:
Yao Xiu is an ordinary young lady from a noble family.Yet it pains her to stay in the household where she doesn't fit in.
The only way out is to get married and start a new family. 
Finally, her wedding approaches.

But she is killed, unexpectedly, right on the eve of her big day.
Before she even knows what's happening, Yao Xiu reopens her eyes right after her "death".
She finds herself trapped in a time loop—forcing her to live through the same day over and over, surviving and dying again and again.

Someone tells her that she has 3 chances to save herself.
If she loses 3 turns, the game ends, and so does her life.

Does each repeated encounter get Yao Xiu one step closer to the truth?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/466810/Soulslayer/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
姚修是一位出身名门望族的普通千金小姐，却因生活在一个与自己格格不入的家庭而感到痛苦。
唯一的出路就是结婚并组建新的家庭。
终于，她的婚礼临近了。

但就在她重要日子的前夕，她出人意料地被杀了。
还没等她意识到发生了什么，姚修就在“死”后重新睁开了眼睛。
她发现自己陷入了时间循环——迫使她一遍又一遍地经历同一天，一次又一次地生存和死亡。

有人告诉她，她有3次自救的机会。
如果她输了3个回合，游戏就会结束，她的生活也会结束。

每一次的重逢，是否都让姚修离真相更近了一步？

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/466810/Soulslayer/]Steam[/url]]
